column2: My worth is tied to my independence and professional success; Aging is a profound shift leading to new clarity and purpose; Emotional needs are signals for introspection; I can navigate natural life processes with wisdom.

If I admit my loneliness, it means my life choices were wrong; Mainstream medicine is impersonal and won't address my deeper needs; Creativity and purpose are essential for my well-being; Alternative approaches can be truly impactful and real, offering validation and new perspectives; Understanding aging as a natural shift, particularly menopause, is key to finding clarity, purpose, and renewed creativity; My experiences are part of a larger, natural process that can be understood and navigated with wisdom.

Isolating myself (less so, as introspection is now a focus), avoiding mainstream medical help, overfocusing on work, suppressing emotional needs (less so, as introspection is encouraged), actively seeking and engaging with introspective workshops/alternative approaches, reframing physical and mental changes as signals for deeper understanding.

I'm on the cusp of understanding something profound about myself; My best years are not necessarily behind me, but shifting; This workshop truly resonated and offers a real path; Aging is a shift, a new phase of being, not a decline; My mental fog, withdrawal, and fading feelings are signals for introspection, deeply connected to natural body changes like menopause; My experiences are part of a larger, natural process that can be understood and navigated; I can discover a different kind of clarity, new purpose, and renewed creativity.

Loneliness (reframed as a signal), numbness (reframed as a signal), curiosity, deep engagement, hope, optimism, strong sense of validation, excitement about new understanding, reduced frustration/anxiety about aging.

Withdrawing socially (less emphasis on this as a negative, more as a period of introspection), avoiding mirrors, rejecting conventional treatment, actively seeking and enthusiastically engaging with alternative therapies and introspective workshops, openly articulating new perspectives on aging and menopause.
